# Bar chart (`bar-chart`)

Small column chart with labels.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBarChart` (types in `dist/web/charts/barChart.d.ts`): `.mh-bar-chart`: a small column chart with labels under the columns, an optional axis and value labels, and onecolumn that can stand out. Colours from `--mh-series-N` or the accent, per chart or per column; negative valueshang below the zero line. Fills its container's width; the height follows the size.

```ts
export function createBarChart(options: BarChartOptions): BarChartHandle;

export interface BarChartOptions {
  bars: readonly BarDatum[];
  /** What it shows ("Energy used per day"); the values are added for screen readers. */
  label: string;
  color?: ChartColor;
  /** Bottom and top of the scale; default a round scale over the data that includes zero. */
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Gridlines with tick labels (default true). */
  axis?: boolean;
  /** About how many steps the axis has (default 4). */
  ticks?: number;
  /** The value above each column. */
  showValues?: boolean;
  /** Index of the column to stand out ("today"); the others are dimmed. */
  highlight?: number;
  /** Show every n-th label; default 1 up to 12 columns, then about eight labels. */
  labelEvery?: number;
  size?: ChartSize;
  /** Formats values in the value labels and the summary. */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
}

export interface BarChartHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown. */
  update(options: BarChartOptions): void;
}
```

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBarChart, createButton, type BarChartOptions } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
const weeks = {
  this: [6.2, 5.8, 7.4, 4.9, 6.6, 8.1, 7.2],
  last: [5.9, 6.4, 6.1, 5.2, 7.0, 7.7, 6.8],
};

const options = (week: keyof typeof weeks): BarChartOptions => ({
  bars: weeks[week].map((value, i) => ({ label: days[i]!, value })),
  label: week === 'this' ? 'Energy used per day this week' : 'Energy used per day last week',
  showValues: true,
  highlight: week === 'this' ? 6 : undefined,
  format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} kWh`,
});

let week: keyof typeof weeks = 'this';
const chart = createBarChart(options(week));
const toggle = createButton({
  label: 'Show last week',
  variant: 'secondary',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => {
    week = week === 'this' ? 'last' : 'this';
    chart.update(options(week));
    toggle.setLabel(week === 'this' ? 'Show last week' : 'Show this week');
  },
});

document.body.append(chart.el, toggle.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BarChart, Button } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
const weeks = {
  this: [6.2, 5.8, 7.4, 4.9, 6.6, 8.1, 7.2],
  last: [5.9, 6.4, 6.1, 5.2, 7.0, 7.7, 6.8],
};

export function BarChartExample() {
  const [week, setWeek] = useState<keyof typeof weeks>('this');
  return (
    <>
      <BarChart
        bars={weeks[week].map((value, i) => ({ label: days[i]!, value }))}
        label={`Energy used per day ${week} week`}
        showValues
        highlight={week === 'this' ? 6 : undefined}
        format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} kWh`}
      />
      <Button variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setWeek(week === 'this' ? 'last' : 'this')}>
        {week === 'this' ? 'Show last week' : 'Show this week'}
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```
